functions.name: TwistAxis
functions.docs: The order of the angular constraints (for settings held in vectors etc)

functions.name: Axis
functions.docs: Get the local-space axis for the specified constraint type. This will be one of the cardinal axes.

functions.name: AxisIndex
functions.docs: Get the local-space axis index for the specified constraint type. This can be used to index the vectors of a transform matrix for example.
